FIX B (SECONDARY — Trino format() printf canonical):
  - Added a new H3 `### LEADING CANONICAL — Trino format(format_string, args...) — printf / Java-Formatter-style string building` in resources/23-sql-best-practices-olap.md, slotted BETWEEN §3.1A (string-split family) and §3.1B (SUM(DECIMAL)) — thematically grouped with other string-function canonicals. r23 chosen as the GENERIC SQL-function home (NOT r27, which is Oracle-migration-titled).
  - Content (~60 lines): keyword-anchors blockquote covers (Trino format function, printf Trino, build display string, format string Trino, String.format Trino, format number with commas, format vs concat, format thousands separator, format percent, zero-pad integer Trino). Signature: `format(format_string, args...) -> varchar` — Java Formatter / printf style. 7-row specifier table: `%s`, `%d`, `%,d`, `%05d`, `%.2f`, `%,.2f`, `%.1f%%`. Worked example: `format('User %s made %d purchases totaling $%,.2f', user_id, purchase_count, total_amount)` => `'User U-1234 made 17 purchases totaling $1,234.56'`. 'Why prefer format() over long || chains' rationale (auto type conversion, comma-grouping, no per-piece CAST-to-varchar).
  - 4-row distinguish-from-related-functions table: format() vs format_datetime (Joda) vs date_format (MySQL) vs json_format — clarifies which is which.
  - 5-row DO-NOT-WRITE: 'Trino has no format() / no printf' (FALSE), confusion with format_datetime/date_format/json_format (WRONG FUNCTION). Cross-ref to r27 §7A.3.1's migration-specific use of format() in the FQ-quarter macro.
  - WebSearch-verified at trino.io/docs/467/functions/string.html and trino.io/docs/current/functions/string.html — format() documented: `format(format_string, args...)` returns varchar, uses Java Formatter syntax. Sample examples found: `format('%s%%', 123)`, `format('%.5f', pi())`, `format('%,.2f', 1234567.89)`, `format('%1$tA, %1$tB %1$te, %1$tY', date '2006-07-04')`.
